description: Iowa unemployment claims and weekly certifications are handled in IowaWORKS. Filing the initial claim alone does not request every weekly payment.
introduction: Iowa unemployment claims and weekly certifications are handled in IowaWORKS. Filing the initial claim alone does not request every weekly payment.

sections.who: IWD checks covered wages, the reason employment ended, and whether you are able and available for work. Total or partial unemployment may qualify; work-search requirements can be waived in specified circumstances.
sections.get: Eligible claimants receive weekly unemployment benefits. The agency determines the payment from the claim and weekly information.
sections.docs: Prepare your Social Security number, contact details, employer payroll address, employment dates, separation reason and vacation or severance information. Have identity-verification information ready.
sections.apply:
1. Register at IowaWORKS and complete the unemployment initial claim, including ID.me verification. A local IowaWORKS Center can help.

  2. File the separate weekly claim for each requested week. Unless waived, log four reemployment activities, including at least three job applications. Report gross wages and other requested payments accurately.
sections.after: Check claim messages and complete weekly certification. Weekly claims are available every day except Saturday. Keep activity records and follow any fact-finding or appeal instructions. Claim help: 866-239-0843.

faqs: Is the initial claim enough to keep receiving payments?
No. File a weekly claim for each week requested.
Can weekly claims be filed Saturday?
No. IWD excludes Saturday from weekly filing.
Unless waived, four weekly activities are required, with at least three job applications.
Where can I get filing help?
A local IowaWORKS Center or customer service at 866-239-0843.
